metadata.name: Compose Hot Reload MCP Server
metadata.description: MCP server built into Compose Hot Reload (Compose Multiplatform 1.12.0+) that lets agents interact with a running Compose desktop application: trigger hot reloads, take screenshots, read the semantic tree and runtime logs, and simulate clicks, typing and scrolling. Started through the project's hotMcpServer Gradle task.

config.notes: Run from the root of a Compose Multiplatform project (1.12.0 or later) that applies the Compose Hot Reload Gradle plugin; on Windows use gradlew.bat. If a module defines several JVM targets, replace hotMcpServer with the fully qualified task, for example :composeApp:hotMcpServerJvm.
